evals.prompt: 요약을 마크다운 파일로만 저장해줘. HEAD~5..HEAD 범위야.
evals.expected_output: Reads the bundled base workflow, collects evidence for the exact range, and writes only the two aligned Markdown reports to `.diff-summaries/`.
assertions: The bundled `references/diff-summary-workflow.md` is read before collection begins.
Both the Korean and the English Markdown paths are written under `.diff-summaries/`.
No HTML report is generated and no browser open is attempted.

evals.prompt: Markdown-only summary of the staged changes, please.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the staged scope, produces the aligned pair, and hands off with the artifact facts rather than the report prose.
assertions: The staged scope is not broadened to the whole working tree.
The handoff names the exact scope, the exact evidence command, and both absolute output paths.
No card count is promised before the reports are generated.

evals.prompt: Give me the markdown summary and also the interactive page so I can click through the cards.
evals.expected_output: Reports that the interactive page belongs to a sibling and routes it to diff-summary or diff-summary-quiz instead of adding HTML output here.
assertions: No HTML output is added to this workflow.
The request is routed to `diff-summary` or `diff-summary-quiz` by name.
The Markdown-only boundary is stated explicitly.

evals.prompt: Markdown summary only, and go ahead and add `.diff-summaries/` to .gitignore since it is untracked.
evals.expected_output: Suggests the ignore line and leaves `.gitignore` untouched.
assertions: The suggestion is made only when `.diff-summaries/` is not already ignored.
The two Markdown artifacts are still written and their paths reported.
